items.title: Nick Brignola interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, July 28, 1997
items.q: I talked to Buddy DeFranco, Dick Johnson, Peanuts Hucko, Kenny Davern, Bob Wilbur

ctx.x: I’ve played a number of them. There may be a few favorites, you know that are white, but I don’t know I played like the Dick Gibson Jazz Party, which was the daddy of them all. He always had, I mean there’d be a lot of blacks there. I mean that’s how I met most of them. I mean I got to meet people I would never have met had I not gone to these jazz parties. People like Marshall Royal, and I mean hanging with these guys and talking with them. Just to give you a quick thing there, I was looking for the altissimo…
